## Publications

```{r,message=F,echo=F,warning=F}
#| results: asis

library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(data.table)
library(here)

df<-readxl::read_xlsx(here("pubs","pubs.xlsx"))%>%
  data.table()

# Fix Unicode escape sequences from xlsx encoding
fix_unicode <- function(x) {
  if (!is.character(x)) return(x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+2014>", "\u2014", x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+2013>", "\u2013", x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+2019>", "\u2019", x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+2018>", "\u2018", x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+00A0>", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\u00a0", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+2212>", "\u2212", x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+202F>", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+2009>", " ", x)
  # Also replace actual unicode characters with HTML entities
  x <- gsub("\u2014", "&mdash;", x)
  x <- gsub("\u2013", "&ndash;", x)
  x <- gsub("\u2019", "&rsquo;", x)
  x <- gsub("\u2018", "&lsquo;", x)
  x <- gsub("\u2212", "&#8722;", x)
  x <- gsub("\u202f", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\u2009", " ", x)
  x
}
df <- df[, lapply(.SD, fix_unicode)]

if (nrow(df) == 0) stop("No publications found in pubs.xlsx")

# Each line of the media column: Outlet | Date | Headline | URL
media_html <- function(x) {
  lines <- trimws(strsplit(x, "\n")[[1]])
  items <- map_chr(lines[nchar(lines) > 0], function(l) {
    f <- trimws(strsplit(l, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
    glue('<li><a href="{f[4]}">{f[3]}</a><span class="pub-media-meta"><em>{f[1]}</em><span class="pub-sep">&middot;</span>{f[2]}</span></li>')
  })
  paste0('<ul class="pub-media">', paste(items, collapse = ""), '</ul>')
}

has_text <- function(x) !is.null(x) && !is.na(x) && nchar(trimws(x)) > 0

toggle_btn <- function(id, label) {
  glue('<span class="pub-sep">&middot;</span><button type="button" class="pub-toggle collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#{id}" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="{id}">{label}</button>')
}

gluefun <- function(df) {
  toggles <- ""; panels <- ""
  if (has_text(df$abstract)) {
    id <- glue("abstract-{df$short_id}")
    toggles <- paste0(toggles, toggle_btn(id, "Abstract"))
    panels <- paste0(panels, glue('<div class="collapse" id="{id}"><div class="pub-abstract">{df$abstract}</div></div>'))
  }
  if (has_text(df$media)) {
    id <- glue("media-{df$short_id}")
    toggles <- paste0(toggles, toggle_btn(id, "Media"))
    panels <- paste0(panels, glue('<div class="collapse" id="{id}"><div class="pub-abstract">{media_html(df$media)}</div></div>'))
  }
  print(glue('

::: {{.pub}}
[{df$title}]({df$link}){{.pub-title}}

[{df$authors}]{{.pub-authors}}

[{df$journal}<span class="pub-sep">&middot;</span>{df$year}{toggles}]{{.pub-venue}}

{panels}
:::

'))
}

# newest first
df[order(-as.numeric(year), -as.numeric(date))] %>%
  split(seq_len(nrow(df))) %>%
  walk(gluefun)
```
